name: component-card-evidence
goal: Component cards show only screenshots, neutral names and clickable consumers; incomplete visual coverage blocks verification and handoff.

steps.title: Identify the regression, prior working behavior, root cause, and evidence.
steps.evidence: The prior catalog loop handed off before full verification. Historical 05c9384 has failed ledger/reasons gates; Account Menu and Model Cards have no scenarios or screenshots. Cards also expose unwanted summaries, contains and status fields.

steps.title: Explain why existing standardized tests missed the regression; name the coverage gap and reusable test or shared guard change.
steps.evidence: Standard catalog SSR and browser tests accepted extra metadata and explicit gaps but did not assert completion blocks for absent component preview bindings. Strengthen existing catalog, usage and preview-binding checks; keep negative evidence honesty tests.

steps.title: Strengthen the existing standardized test; commit it before repair, run it failing with loop record --phase red, and preserve the assertion.
steps.evidence: At e1593dcf the committed standard tests fail: component.cards retain extra metadata, usage links are missing, and registryGate accepts a component with no preview. Browser checkpoints captured at three widths.

steps.title: Propose a root-cause repair and an automated guard for the identified failure.
steps.evidence: Reuse EntityLink for three distinct consumers, remove card-only metadata, keep provenance in the image link tooltip, rename Model Cards without changing identity, and reject active component manifests without a required own screenshot preview.

steps.title: Implement the repair and wire the prevention test or guard into normal project verification.
steps.evidence: Simplified cards to screenshots, neutral titles and three distinct consumer links. Screenshot origin remains in the link tooltip. Registry checks now reject active components without required preview bindings; local and generated guidance require real visual evidence and repaired failure gates.

steps.title: Rerun the same unchanged regression test at a separate fix commit with loop record --phase green; preserve passing proof.
steps.evidence: Final frozen-corpus replay: red de1a49cc96d960a6cdcaa03dfdab06d0591ddbcbbb438dd6036e9b7903ac0597 at f0bd59e882634a75a026bef66ca53400f8c1b54d; green ab4ba814dfe231b1163d2439ee0e5ad24b7388ecae28e4e8688dfe5a831912dc at 19e257259b34fe4f56dcaa35c2e6b7ab9d89cd26. Same command: 31 unit tests and 8 browser tests pass. Includes Harness latency and process-memory observations.

steps.title: In an isolated fixture or temporary workspace, prove reintroducing the original failure makes the guard fail; restore and prove it passes.
steps.evidence: The unchanged memoryTree registry fixture rejects an active component without a preview, accepts its own required screenshot binding, and exempts retired/nonvisual units. Sealed red replays the original accepting behavior; sealed green proves rejection.

steps.title: Repeat until the guard and relevant project checks pass; verify affected UI flows with fresh inspected screenshots and no unexpected browser errors; preserve diagnostics and keep pending while proof fails.
steps.evidence: Pending: Reports check passes 610 tests; focused clean builds and own Account menu/Model Cards captures pass. 160 existing active components still lack explicit preview bindings. Full current-commit verification and final task audit must pass before handoff or merge.
